correctness.rationale: For α,θ>0,0<p<1, setting λ=θ/p in EPQL(y)=p^y θ[α(θ+p)+θ(y+1)]/[(α+1)(θ+p)^{y+2}] cancels p^{y+2} and yields exact PQL(y;α,λ) at every y≥0. For any positive λ choose p=1/2, θ=λ/2, so families have identical images. The PQL PGF λ α/[(α+1)(λ+1−s)] + λ²/[(α+1)(λ+1−s)²] has a genuine unique double pole at s=λ+1; pole and leading coefficient identify λ and α uniquely. Thus full triple equivalence classes are exactly constant α and θ/p. An iid univariate likelihood depends on θ,p only through θ/p; its score in direction (0,θ,p) vanishes pointwise, making Fisher information singular when defined. SymPy algebra independently verified full-parameter PMF ratio 1; inspected exact-rational checker supports but does not prove the infinite identity.
